title: Templates for this module
body: Copy-ready structures you can reuse in your own engagements. Examples are fictional.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Buying uncertainty, options compared, selected path, why lighter options suffice/not, scope/data/users, success/failure, limits, readiness, approvals, owner/date, stop rule

lines.label: Fictional example

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: No automatic approval from score or sponsor enthusiasm; live process checked.
